title: Southeast Alaska Salmon Purse Seine Fishery Section 3-A
full_text:
Forrest Bowers, Acting Director

Doug Vincent-Lang, Commissioner

Region I, Petersburg Area Office Petersburg, AK 99833

Advisory Announcement For Immediate Release: August 28, 2026

Juneau, AK 99811-5526

CONTACT: Troy Thynes Region I Management Coordinator troy.thynes@alaska.gov (907) 772-3801

SOUTHEAST ALASKA SALMON PURSE SEINE FISHERY SECTION 3-A CORRECTION

The purse seine announcement issued on August 28, 2026, had an error in the Section 3-A Nutkwa Inlet restriction. The following has the correct Section 3-A restrictions.

District 3

The following areas will be open to purse seining from 6:00 a.m., Sunday, August 30, through 9:00 p.m., Monday, August 31, 2026:

Section 3-A: will be open with the following restrictions:

Dall Island Shore: will be closed west of a line from the southernmost tip of Reef Point at 55°03.62′ N lat, 132°58.33′ W long to High Point at 55°01.24′ N lat, 132°57.68′ W long;

Eek Inlet: will be closed within 0.2 nmi of the western shore of Hetta Inlet north of the latitude of Eek Point Light at 55°08.27′ N lat and south of 55°09.33′ N lat;

Hetta Inlet: will be closed north of 55°12.00′ N lat;

Hetta Lake Cove: will be closed within 0.3 nmi of the eastern shore of Hetta Inlet north of 55°09.28′ N lat and south of 55°10.62′ N lat;

Hassiah Inlet and Mabel Bay: will be closed east of 132°35.00′ W long and south of the latitude of the northern tip of Helen Island at 54°59.43′ N lat;

Kassa Inlet: will be closed east of the longitude of Kassa Point at 132°31.62′ W long;

Klakas Inlet: will be closed north of 54°57.17′ N lat;

Max Cove: will be closed south of 54°57.17′ N lat;

Nutkwa Inlet: will be closed north of 55°07.00′ N lat;

Sukkwan Strait: will be closed west of 132°46.66′ W long.

All other lines, times, and restrictions from the seine announcement released on August 28, will remain in effect.

The Emergency Order corresponding with this announcement is EO 1S6726.
